name: vwap breakdown with trend
note: VWAP-benchmarked sell algos accelerate once price loses the anchor, and longs who bought above VWAP are underwater and forced to exit to avoid larger loss versus benchmark.

name: ema10/30 death cross
note: The same CTA crossover systems flip to selling in size; longs from the prior uptrend have stops just below this cross and are forced out, compounding the move.

name: dip buy in uptrend
note: Short-term panic sellers dump into a pullback that is still above the longer trend average; they are stop/margin driven, not fundamental, and dip-buying algos absorb them as the larger uptrend reasserts.

name: rip sell in downtrend
note: Late chasers buy a bounce within a still-declining longer trend; they're momentum-driven with no structural backing and are forced to sell back as the dominant downtrend resumes.

name: vwap_overbought_fade
note: VWAP-benchmarked buy programs push price above fair value on a fixed schedule, not on conviction; when their buying quota is filled, chase-buyers stuck above VWAP have no bid support left and are forced to sell into the reversion.

name: vol_expansion_downtrend
note: The same vol-targeting funds cut exposure when realized vol jumps above the longer baseline; in a falling market that forced deleveraging is one-directional selling that can't pause to wait for a better price.

name: trend_momentum_continuation_short
note: Mirror of the long case: CTAs add shorts on any negative short-term push below the longer trend average, and dip-buyers betting on a bounce are forced to sell out as the trend desks keep pressing.

name: uptrend_pullback_reclaim
note: Systematic dip-buy programs trigger the moment price reclaims the short average inside a bigger uptrend; shorts who faded the pullback get stopped as that scheduled flow arrives all at once, not gradually.
